IN PHOTOS | The 4th Howitzer Platoon, Bravo Battery, 5th Field Artillery Battalion, Artillery Regiment of the Philippine Army culminated its Field Artillery Gunnery Proficiency Training (FAGPT) through a Live Fire Exercise (LFE) at Doña Josefa Firebase, Fort Magsaysay, Nueva Ecija on 13-14 December 2025.

The 2-week training aimed at sharpening the knowledge and skills of the 4th Howitzer Platoon’s gun crew, further evaluating their technical proficiency based on their respective designations in the gunnery team. 

They demonstrated their enhanced skills as they efficiently delivered fire missions during the LFE. | via Rex Espiritu

data.text:
The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) welcomes the appointment of former Philippine National Police (PNP) Chief Gen. Nicolas Torre III as the new MMDA General Manager.

The MMDA expresses its full support to the decision of President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. in his trust for Gen. Torre, whose extensive experience in public service and law enforcement is expected to further strengthen the MMDA’s mandate in traffic management and public safety, among others, across Metro Manila.

"Gen. Torre is a welcome addition to the MMDA family. I am sure he will be a big help to the agency," Chairman Atty. Don Artes said.

The MMDA likewise extends its sincere appreciation to former General Manager Procopio Lipana for his dedication and valuable contributions to MMDA for more than three years, which helped advance key programs and institutional reforms in the agency.

The MMDA remains committed to continuing its mission of ensuring safe, efficient, and orderly mobility and development in Metro Manila with the appointment of Gen. Torre. #mmda
